column1: # Counting key | check aliases (without -negative) | developer request

column3: When a delivery option wraps to a second line in translation, part of the name disappears. Can you fix the row without shortening the text?
Our design font is supposed to follow the text size setting. The typeface and size should both survive repeated updates. What would you change?
The old row can still be described as selected after the selection moves. Can you make both rows reflect the current selection?
Marking an item selected seems to remove information it had before. Can we update selection without disturbing its other properties?
Navigation to a phrase works for plain English but lands on the wrong text after emoji. Can you repair it without changing the displayed text?
When a panel closes the background doesn't always return to its previous state. How should this screen handle opening and closing it more than once?
A disabled command can still run through another activation path. Can you make the control respect its current enabled state?
The contrast report for midtones disagrees with the design team's luminance calculation. Can you correct the computation?
Our contrast utility gets different answers for equivalent colors in different color spaces. Can you make comparisons consistent?
The contrast tool reports the same result even when the selected appearance changes. What path through this code needs updating?
Our contrast tool is only supposed to grade opaque pairs. A translucent pair gets a numeric result. What would you change?

column2: staleaction staleidentity stalebutton staleshortcut generation stale documents
column3: After refreshing a row, an action captured earlier can operate on the wrong record. Can you repair the ownership without losing the current action?
A tester can reach the row but not all its individual controls. Can you preserve the grouping and still let people operate the children?
An item we've removed is still in the container's navigation list. Can you keep the list in sync without changing ordinary controls?
Our search offers an overlapping-matches option, but the navigation stops look identical with it on and off. Can you fix the search?
After editing the document, the next search jump continues from an unrelated old location. Can you define a safe restart?
A previously retained navigation shortcut still moves through the document after the query changes. Can you prevent old searches affecting the new one?
Editing the text outside our search callback leaves old search hits active. Can you make navigation use the current content?
The screen sends the same accessibility notification for changes with different navigation consequences. Can you select the appropriate request without resetting unrelated state?
An observer keeps reacting after the screen stops listening. Can you make teardown and a subsequent restart reliable?
The player says I can seek through an interval that was only buffered. How should the inspector describe these two ranges?
Our report calls the player ready just because its buffer is full. How should we expose the available status without promising playback?
The inspector labels a stream live when all it knows is that the duration is indefinite. What should it report instead?
The audio inspector calls ordinary language tracks described audio. How can we identify the marked options?
Opening the inspector before an item arrives says there are no accessible tracks. Can we distinguish not loaded from a successful empty result?
Opening the track inspector changes the chosen audio or captions. Can you make inspection read-only?
When we ask for one language, this picker can select a different one. Fix matching without silently changing languages.
Our captions menu offers a forced-only translation as if it were full subtitles. Can you keep those choices distinct?
Focus is requested as soon as Close is pressed, before dismissal finishes. How would you handle completion and cancellation?
A delayed close callback can restore focus for a presentation that has already been replaced. Can you fix that race?
A dismissal callback can reenter the close path while the first transition is unfinished. How can we avoid restoring twice?
After a refresh the original focus target may no longer belong here. Can you restore only to a usable target or fallback?
A decorative part of this view is getting its own navigation stop. Can you remove just that stop?
A control keeps the old accessible name after its content changes. Can you update the same control rather than replace it?
The optional effect still plays when the person asks for reduced motion. Can we honor their setting without changing the normal experience?
After switching from an item with help text to one without it, the old help is still there. Can you repair the update path?
The added shortcut works but the ordinary action no longer does. Can you keep both paths working on the current item?
Moving to the previous result jumps in the same direction as Next. Can you correct navigation including the ends of the list?
The speed control changes playback but continues to describe the previous setting. Can you synchronize the displayed and accessible state?
Reapplying an unchanged value generates another change event. Can we notify once for a real transition?
People who change their text-size setting while this screen is open don't get the expected update. Can the existing content respond in place?
A late response from an earlier request overwrites a newer result. Can you give the current request ownership of the update?
The text has changed since validation started, but the old result is still applied. Can you preserve edits and reject that reply?
The player can replace its item from outside this view. Can you prevent an old lookup from updating the new item's details?
A service sometimes delivers its completion twice. Can you apply the first valid result only?
The control state changes but its status text tells a different story. Can you keep the two consistent on successive updates?
Receiving the same preference twice restarts work that should only happen on a transition. Can you avoid the repeat?
A requested option isn't in the available list. Can the picker leave the current choice intact instead of silently picking a replacement?
When someone asks for described audio and no matching track exists, keep the previous choice. Does the picker do that?
Off is shown even for a group that requires a selection. Can you honor the actual group's permission?
A rename or reorder moves the selection to a different item. Can you preserve identity and clear a selection only if its item is gone?
The server returned duplicate IDs. Can you reject the ambiguous update without leaving a partially updated screen?
Tab navigation takes users to an unavailable control. Can you repair the chain when eligibility changes?
Removing a field leaves a stale key-view link. Can you undo links owned by this component?
After eligibility changes, one Tab path still leads to a disabled button. Check the incoming links as well as the outgoing loop.
An invalid entry still reaches Save. Can you show the validation result and keep the user's input without submitting it?
Error help remains after the user corrects the field. Can you clear only the transient error and restore the previous help?
The save callback can trigger another submit before the first finishes. Can you prevent duplicate submission?
With reduced motion enabled the results disappear instead of just losing the animation. Can you preserve the content?
A detached button retained by other code can still act on the shelf. Can you reject it while keeping the current button usable?
Our buttons have accessibility metadata but no visible titles. Can you make the ordinary controls identifiable too?
The wrapper updates its SwiftUI state but the native button can still send to the previous target. Can you fix the binding and teardown?
An older cancelled load can cancel the current load. Can you keep cancellation local to its request?
A change in the track picker doesn't reach the current player item. Can you connect the existing control to the actual selection?
Choosing Off from an out-of-date menu clears captions on the replacement item. Can you prevent that?
The player has a selection that isn't listed in our menu, and we show it as Off. Can you distinguish the states?
A merged table cell occupies several coordinates. When users explore the table by coordinate, does each covered position resolve to the right cell?
An editor is now read-only. Can you check that its available actions and help change together?
The editor can perform edits but the requested editing actions aren't in the intended category. Can you bring configuration and default behavior into agreement?
A match covering only part of a composed character should not be offered as a navigation destination. Does this code enforce that?
The two named shortcuts on this card should invoke different commands. Could you check the names and what each one actually calls?
Reordering the children should update their navigation order without changing the surviving objects. Does this implementation do that?
The previous timeline remains visible when information for the next item is unavailable. Can you correct the state transition?
After stopping and restarting preference observation, queued work from the old subscription must not change this screen. Does the code handle that?
Our refreshed outline can still be queried through an old node object. How can we avoid showing obsolete children?
Setting the same value through the toggle binding twice should not run its change action twice. Can you check both repeated and changed writes?
